summary: PNG image parser that first validates the 8-byte PNG signature (reading any missing header bytes through CallbackDispatchWithNullGuard and comparing against a reference with BoundedMemcmpAgainstReference), then iteratively reads 4-byte chunk lengths and 4-byte chunk types, dispatching IHDR, PLTE, IEND, gAMA, sRGB, tRNS and unknown chunks to per-chunk handlers. Terminates the loop on IDAT, then validates the chunk-state flags (color type 3 requires PLTE before IDAT) and records the IDAT chunk size. Uses longjmp-based error reporting (GuardedCallWithLongjmp) for signature, PLTE and IHDR violations.

local_names.a1: PNG reader/state object (this); header byte counter at +284, chunk type buffer at +268
local_names.a2: input data buffer (signature and chunk data); signature bytes read from a2+32 onward
local_names.v3: number of signature bytes already consumed (this+284)
local_names.v4: signature bytes consumed before this call
local_names.v7: current chunk length decoded by ByteArrayToInt (big-endian)
local_names.v6: chunk-type buffer pointer (this+268) used for tag dispatch

operations.description: Signature stage: read the byte counter v3 = this+284 and proceed only while fewer than 8 signature bytes have been consumed.
CallbackDispatchWithNullGuard(a1, a2 + 32 + v3, 8 - v3): fetch the missing signature bytes into the input buffer.
Mark all 8 signature bytes as consumed: this+284 = 8.
BoundedMemcmpAgainstReference(a2 + 32, v4, v5): compare the received signature against the expected PNG signature; a non-zero result is a mismatch.
On signature mismatch, GuardedCallWithLongjmp reports 'Not a PNG file' when fewer than 4 signature bytes were present, otherwise 'PNG file corrupted by ASCII conversion'.
Chunk iteration loop: repeatedly read a 4-byte length, decode the chunk type into the buffer at this+268 and dispatch to a per-chunk handler until an IDAT chunk terminates the loop.
CallbackDispatchWithNullGuard(v2, &a1, 4): read the 4-byte chunk length field into the local buffer.
ByteArrayToInt(&a1): decode the 4-byte length into the chunk length v7.
AnimationHandleAlloc(v2): allocate/refresh the per-chunk scratch state.
sub_517F58(v2, v2 + 268, 4): copy the 4-byte chunk type tag into the chunk-type buffer at this+268.
Dispatch the chunk type tag at this+268: when it equals 'IHDR', call sub_5188B4(v2, a2, v7) to parse the header chunk.
Dispatch on the chunk type tag: when it equals 'PLTE', call sub_518AAA(v2, a2, v7) to parse the palette chunk.
Dispatch on the chunk type tag: when it equals 'IEND', call sub_518BD4(v2, a2, v7) to handle the end marker.
Dispatch on the chunk type tag: 'IDAT' terminates the loop; otherwise 'gAMA' -> sub_518C1E, 'sRGB' -> sub_518D29, 'tRNS' -> sub_518E18, and any other tag -> sub_518FCF(v2, a2, v7).

Post-loop chunk-state validation: read the flags at this+88; when bit 0 (IHDR seen) is set and the color type at this+278 equals 3 (indexed) while bit 1 (PLTE seen) is clear, GuardedCallWithLongjmp reports 'Missing PLTE before IDAT'; otherwise it reports 'Missing IHDR before IDAT'.
Record chunk parse state: set bit 2 of the flags word (this+88 |= 4) and store the IDAT chunk length into this+252.
Return the flags word after validation.
